newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH BONDS IGNORE BUDGET AND END FLAT.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH BONDS IGNORE BUDGET AND END FLAT.

text.p: 1615/1315 GMT - Bonds end moderate Tuesday session
unchanged, recouping earlier losses as underlying domestic
sentiment remains positive, operators say. Financial markets
largely ignore 1997 budget as it features "no surpirses". Markka
ends dull session flat vs mark.
*FIM-06 yld pct 7.15 vs 7.15 *06 gap over Bund bps 72 vs 75
*FIM-04 yld pct 6.82 vs 6.82 *FIM-99 yld pct 4.59 vs 4.61
*Sept FRAs pct 3.41 vs 3.43 *June FRAs pct 4.07 vs 4.08
*SEK/FIM 0.6762 vs 0.6771 *ECU index 103.90 vs 103.90
Finnish bonds recouped earlier losses to end unchanged on Tuesday as domestic sentiment remained surprisingly upbeat, dealers said.
The publication of the 1997 budget was largely ignored by the financial markets as it did not hold any big surprises.
"The budget did not feature anything that wasn't known beforehand," one dealer noted.

Dealers said the focus would be on the U.S. after The Wall Street Journal reported that the Federal Reserve was considering a sharper than expected rise in interest rates unless signs of slower growth would appear in the next three weeks.
"The U.S. indicators will set the pace for the rest of the week," one dealer said.
The NAPM August report on business conditions is due today at 1700/1400 GMT and U.S. August payrolls data will be published on Friday at 1530/1230 GMT.
The markka closed unchanged against the mark, lacking interest on both sides, forex dealers said.
"The dollar surge in the morning helped the crosses, but the markka fell soon back to its inital levels," one said.
The DEM/FIM was seen in a 3.02-3.04 range in the near-term.
-- Veera Heinonen, Helsinki newsroom + 358 - 0 - 680 50 240
